sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spots" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "category_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spot_tags" ("spot_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES spots (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("spot_id", "tag"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spot_photos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "spot_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES spots (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "image_bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "thumbnail_bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drones" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'quadcopter', "takeoff_weight_grams" REAL NULL, "max_speed_meters_per_second" REAL NULL, "length_mm" REAL NULL, "width_mm" REAL NULL, "height_mm" REAL NULL, "propeller_diameter_inches" REAL NULL, "propeller_pitch_inches" REAL NULL, "propeller_count" INTEGER NULL, "motor_count" INTEGER NULL, "motor_kv" REAL NULL, "cruise_speed_meters_per_second" REAL NULL, "max_climb_rate_meters_per_second" REAL NULL, "hover_power_watts" REAL NULL, "cruise_power_watts" REAL NULL, "max_power_watts" REAL NULL, "reference_voltage_volts" REAL NULL, "configuration" TEXT NULL, "propeller_description" TEXT NULL, "motor_description" TEXT NULL, "esc_description" TEXT NULL, "measurement_context" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "drone_parameter_sources" ("drone_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES drones (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "parameter_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("drone_id", "parameter_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batteries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "chemistry" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LiPo', "cell_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "capacity_mah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_grams" REAL NULL, "cycle_count" INTEGER NULL, "is_type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_type" IN (0, 1)), "type_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES batteries (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "nominal_voltage_volts" REAL NULL, "energy_wh" REAL NULL, "charge_percent" REAL NULL, "availability" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "condition_notes" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_drones" ("battery_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES batteries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "drone_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES drones (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("battery_id", "drone_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flight_plans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "drone_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES drones (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "start_spot_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES spots (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "planning_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "battery_flight_plans" ("battery_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES batteries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES flight_plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("battery_id", "plan_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "radio_equipment" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "frequency_mhz" REAL NULL, "max_power_mw" REAL NULL, "protocol" TEXT NULL, "transmitter" TEXT NULL, "receiver" TEXT NULL, "tx_antenna" TEXT NULL, "rx_antenna" TEXT NULL, "tx_polarization" TEXT NULL, "rx_polarization" TEXT NULL, "bandwidth_khz" REAL NULL, "sensitivity_dbm" REAL NULL, "tx_gain_dbi" REAL NULL, "rx_gain_dbi" REAL NULL, "tx_loss_db" REAL NULL, "rx_loss_db" REAL NULL, "receiver_specifications" TEXT NULL, "specification_source" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "radio_equipment_drones" ("equipment_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES radio_equipment (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "drone_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES drones (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("equipment_id", "drone_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flight_waypoints" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES flight_plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sequence_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "height_meters" REAL NULL, "speed_meters_per_second" REAL NULL, "height_reference" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified', "altitude_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'absolute');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX spots_category_id ON spots (category_key, id)
CREATE INDEX spots_favorite_id ON spots (is_favorite, id)
CREATE INDEX spot_tags_tag_spot ON spot_tags (tag, spot_id)
